_meta.adr: ADR-037 fragment — declarative WMO (Wet Markt en Overheid, Mededingingswet ch. 4b) compliance: CommercialActivity, IntegralCostPrice, ActivityCostAllocation, AlgemeenBelangBesluit, ACMReport, AlertLog (cross-subsidy detector), WMOAuditLog (immutable), MarketBenchmark. Merged additively into shillinq_register.json at load (SettingsService::deepMergeConfig).
_meta.description: Phase 1+2 WMO compliance engine. Declares 8 schemas plus their x-openregister-lifecycle, x-openregister-aggregations and x-openregister-rbac blocks; relations are property-level $ref. Per-period IKP records are immutable (status=voorlopig|definitief); ActivityCostAllocation splits are reversible audit records; ACMReport is write-once after digital signature; WMOAuditLog has 7-year retention per Mededingingswet bewaartermijn.

CommercialActivity.title: Commercial Activity
CommercialActivity.description: Per-bestuursorgaan commercial activity register. First-class record (not a free-form GL tag) so ACM meldingstatus, ABB exemption, kostprijsmethode, kostenplaats/kostendrager coupling, marktcontext and audit trail attach declaratively. An annual review-task is auto-generated when lastReviewedAt is > 365 days old (REQ-WMO-001 §c).

wmo-annual-review-detector.name: Annual review-task generator
wmo-annual-review-detector.description: Daily walker over all active CommercialActivity records. Emits a 'wmo-annual-review' task whenever lastReviewedAt is > 365 days old (REQ-WMO-001 §c). Composed by CommercialActivityReviewService and dispatched via the Nextcloud notification + IJobList task surface.

wmo-cross-subsidy-detector.name: Cross-subsidy detector
wmo-cross-subsidy-detector.description: Monthly walker per CommercialActivity, evaluating the 6 REQ-WMO-007 cross-subsidy risk scenarios (loss-financing, omzet-spike-no-IKP-update, overhead-under-allocation, ABB-stale, manual-override-accumulation, potentiele-overhead-onderschatting) plus the REQ-WMO-012 Phase-3 bevoordeling-risk scenario. Emits AlertLog records via CrossSubsidyDetector for any match. Runs the 1st of the month at 02:00 UTC.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Commercial Activity is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

IntegralCostPrice.title: Integral Cost Price
IntegralCostPrice.description: Time-versioned integrale-kostprijs (IKP) record per commercial activity per period. Monthly records are status=voorlopig; the year-end roll-up is signed off as status=definitief on 31 March of the following year. Records are immutable after creation; restatements create a new periode-restatement record rather than mutating prior values.

status.title: Status

wmo-ikp-monthly-calculation.name: Monthly IKP calculation
wmo-ikp-monthly-calculation.description: Monthly calculation of IntegralCostPrice voorlopig per active CommercialActivity. Pulls GL lines tagged with the activity's kostenplaats / kostendrager, applies the geldende OverheadDistributionRule (BBV taakveld 0.4 sleutel), the WACC vermogenskosten rate, and the per-period winstopslag. Persists one IKP record per (commercialActivityId, periode). Runs the 1st of the month at 03:00 UTC.

wmo-ikp-year-end-lock.name: Year-end IKP definitief lock
wmo-ikp-year-end-lock.description: On 31 March of the following fiscal year, aggregates all monthly voorlopig IKP records for the closed FY into a single definitief IKP-YTD record, locked by accountant digital signature (REQ-WMO-002 §year-end lock).

ActivityCostAllocation.title: Activity Cost Allocation
ActivityCostAllocation.description: Immutable, reversible split record. A JournalEntry posted on a GL account linked to a CommercialActivity (via kostenplaats/kostendrager) triggers an automatic split using the geldende OverheadDistributionRule for the posting date. Handmatige overrides require 4-ogen-akkoord (two approver ids) and a motivering; the original record is marked status=overridden and a new record replaces it.

journalEntryId.title: Journal Entry ID

glLineId.title: GL Line ID

originalAmount.title: Original Amount

costObject.title: Kostendrager

amount.title: Amount

journal-entry-posted.name: Activity cost allocation splitter
journal-entry-posted.description: On JournalEntry.created / .transitioned to status=posted, resolve the geldende OverheadDistributionRule for the posting date, match the CommercialActivity by kostenplaats/kostendrager, and persist an ActivityCostAllocation record carrying the PUBL / MO splits. Materialise mode (post splits as additional balanced GL lines) is operator-configurable per administration.

AlgemeenBelangBesluit.title: Public Interest Decision
AlgemeenBelangBesluit.description: AlgemeenBelangBesluit (ABB) lifecycle record. Workflow: concept → raadsvoorstel → raadsbesluit → publicatie → acm-notified → bezwaar → geldig → evaluatie-due → herziening/intrekking. State transitions enforce preconditions (raadsbesluit requires kenmerk; geldig requires publicatieDatum + ACM-kenmerk). Automatic tasks are generated on raadsbesluit (publish gemeenteblad +14d), publicatie (notify ACM +7d), acm-notified (review bezwaarschriften +42d), and when volgendeEvaluatie is reached.

flagDependentActivities.description: When an ABB enters intrekking or herziening, flag dependent CommercialActivity records (those whose exemptionBesluitId points at this ABB) for operator review (REQ-WMO-005 §dependents).

AlertLog.title: Cross-Subsidy Alert
AlertLog.description: Cross-subsidy detector alert. Generated monthly by the CrossSubsidyDetector ScheduledWorkflow for the 6 risk scenarios. Alerts default to assignedTo concerncontroller; if status=open for > 4 weeks the alert escalates to escalation-due assigned to gemeentesecretaris.

MarketBenchmark.title: Market Benchmark
MarketBenchmark.description: Market-benchmark observation for tariff validation and Art. 25j bevoordeling-risk detection (REQ-WMO-012, Phase 3). The IKP calculation step retrieves benchmarks within last 12 months, computes a median, and raises a bevoordeling-risk alert when gehanteerdTarief < median × 0.85 despite gehanteerdTarief >= kostprijsPerEenheid.

detectBevoordelingRisk.description: Phase 3: when a MarketBenchmark is created, recompute the bevoordeling-risk for the linked CommercialActivity's most recent IKP. If gehanteerdTarief < benchmark median × 0.85 while gehanteerdTarief >= kostprijsPerEenheid, emit a HIGH-severity bevoordeling-risk AlertLog (Art. 25j Mededingingswet).
